vintage: transport.data.gouv.fr GTFS stop extraction; scheduled frequency 2026-12-09

lenses.name: Transit stops
lenses.description: Deduplicated public-transport stop points per 10,000 residents. Stops appearing in overlapping GTFS feeds are deduplicated by normalized name and approximately 100-metre rounded coordinates. Stop presence does not measure service frequency, span, speed or reliability, and catalog coverage can vary.

lenses.name: Transit frequency
lenses.description: Scheduled vehicle stop calls on one representative Wednesday, normalized by residents. GTFS calendars and exceptions are applied. Coverage currently includes consolidated regional feeds for Île-de-France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Grand Est, Pays de la Loire, Bretagne, Normandie and Centre-Val de Loire only; missing regions are null, not zero. Values measure theoretical supply, not reliability, speed, crowding or actual operations.
